title: This Congresswoman Says Democrats Should Do ‘Everything’ to Investigate AIPAC
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
After watching **Zeteo** 's new documentary, **'[Night Flower: Inside AIPAC's
Fight for Influence](https://zeteo.com/p/watch-our-new-aipac-documentary-
zeteo),' **which pulls back the curtain on the pro-Israel lobby, Rep. Delia
Ramirez (D-Ill.) says Democrats "**should be doing everything in our power "
**if they regain control of Congress to investigate whether AIPAC should
register as a foreign agent.

In this special, live edition of '**Mehdi Unfiltered** ,' Ramirez discusses
the growing support for [her bill](https://zeteo.com/p/exclusive-us-bill-to-
block-arms-sales) to block weapons to Israel, whether Gaza and AIPAC will be
litmus tests in the 2028 Democratic presidential primaries, and how the
lobbying group's fading influence has forced it into operating **" in the
shadows**."

"**We 're about to welcome the largest pro-peace, anti-AIPAC Congress**,"
Ramirez tells Mehdi, and warns, "**We 're going to destroy their ability to
continue to destroy our world**."

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

During the interview, Ramirez also discusses her [new
bill](https://ramirez.house.gov/media/press-releases/ramirez-introduces-
reimagining-safety-act-legislation-dismantle-dhs-abolish) to abolish ICE and
Customs and Border Protection. The 'Reimaging Safety Act' would also replace
the Department of Homeland Security with a new Department of Community Safety.

"**Getting rid of ICE is not enough because you have to get rid of the agency
that is the poison that has made it possible** ," Ramirez says.
